lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Producer,

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: will you be attending the concert tomorrow?

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I've prepared the finest seat in the house for you,

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: with the best view.
Of course, I'll go.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Awesome!

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: There obviously won't be any playback at this concert,

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: so it's all live.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: That's why, I've put a lot of effort into the stage production

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: and really wanted to show you what I've come up with.
I can't wait to see it!

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: You're always so busy that

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I thought you wouldn't be able to come.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I'm thrilled that's not the case!
I've already prepared all the things I need.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: What do you need to prepare for a concert?
I had to get a light stick so that I can wave it around during the concert.
It's a way of cheering you on.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Ooooh...
I've also got a T-shirt with your face on it.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Wow, you do?
I also had "Noise 4 Life" sewed on it.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Noise...

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: 4 Life...
I'll be right there in the front row cheering you on.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Er...

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Producer.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: How many times do I have to tell you that I'm not a pop idol?
I need to sleep so that I can get in line early in the morning! See you tomorrow!

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Producer?

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I guess you've fallen asleep.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Thanks for your support.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I'll try and give you a great show tomorrow.
